verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost the same, and both are clearly broken. The RSVP CTA has shrunk to the size of the FREE ENTRY/ALL AGES/TASTINGS pills and sits in their row, so it no longer stands out. The 'Sunset Sessions' headline is pushed into the bottom-left and crowds the pills, the italic subhead and date block form a cramped middle cluster, the legal text and URL are too small to read, the product can is tiny, and the missing-asset placeholder is still visible. A is worse because its logo wordmark reads 'SOLSTCE' with a letter missing (a broken brand mark); B keeps 'SOLSTICE' intact.
